manual_mapping_specification: Pinned Electron DEPS places Chromium at src and Electron at src/electron. Pinned Brave package.json and build/commands/lib/config.js place Chromium at src and Brave at src/brave. Literal Chromium source-root prefixes resolve in the shared exact Chromium commit. brave/ strips the src/brave mount prefix. All selected raw Mojom bytes are unaffected by either complete pinned patch set or the complete Brave chromium_src overlay inventory. Mapping semantics are a reviewed specification, not a theorem about GN or DEPS execution.
